name: cloud-diagram
description: Finished, presentation-ready cloud diagram images (SVG + PNG) to embed in docs and slides — a rendered picture, not an editable draw.io file (for that, use aws-drawio-diagram). One skill today, aws-diagram. Amazon Ember typography, squid ink + smile orange skin, official AWS Architecture Icons bundled. 27 visual types, draw.io and Mermaid import. Includes a Python generator (scripts/pygen) that renders spec files to bilingual (ko/en) SVG and PNG sets in the same house style. Fork of hi-space/hi-aws-skills aws-diagram-design 2.3.0 (MIT).
